reuse.why: The change reuses budget writes, sheet access and undo wrappers, but introduces separate group-note storage instead of using the existing notes system.

duplication.why: The eligibility policy is repeated across five SQL queries and a separate JavaScript implementation.

placement.why: Budget actions and handler registration belong in their existing modules, but adding category_groups.notes splits responsibility from the established notes layer.

scope.why: The edits address the requested month-wide actions and their supporting types, registration and tests.

maintainability.why: Maintainers must update six eligibility implementations and reconcile two storage locations for group notes.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The migration and actions.ts use category_groups.notes, bypassing the notes table and notes handlers already used for group notes through useNotes(group.id).

disguised_duplication.where: copyPreviousMonth expresses the same hidden, fixed-group and template eligibility policy as JavaScript guards that the other five actions express in SQL.

abstraction_drift.where: All six month-wide actions obtain group notes from the newly introduced category_groups.notes field rather than the existing shared notes storage; no shared eligibility helper is introduced.
